Placement.description:
Reduction of a test's required-providers list to a CI matrix entry.

The selector calls :func:`placement_for` per test (or per group of tests
sharing identical placements) and emits one matrix entry per unique
placement. The workflow then computes its ``env:`` block from
:attr:`secrets`, its ``services:`` block from :attr:`services`, and picks
the runner vs k8s-job code path from :attr:`mode`.

secrets.description: Sorted, deduplicated list of secret env-var names the *runner* must export. Cluster-internal providers contribute via :attr:`cluster_secrets` instead — those are mounted by the cluster, not by GitHub Actions.
secrets.title: Secrets

cluster_secrets.description: Sorted, deduplicated list of env-var names the in-cluster Job needs from its service ConfigMap. Documentation only — the workflow doesn't pass them, the cluster mounts them. Runner providers' ``runner_secrets`` are promoted here when the placement is k8s mode.
cluster_secrets.title: Cluster Secrets

runtime_env.description: Aggregated static env vars the workflow exports after services are up. Union of every chosen provider's ``runtime_env``; conflicting values for the same key raise.
runtime_env.title: Runtime Env

env_scope.description: Strictest env binding across required providers.
env_scope.title: Env Scope

Placement.title: Placement

ServiceContainer.description:
Definition of a runner-side ephemeral container — maps 1:1 to one entry of GitHub Actions' ``services:`` block.

Provided by ephemeral providers (``image=redis:7-alpine``, etc.) so the
framework can spin up real-but-disposable infrastructure on the runner
without paying the k8s round-trip.

service_name.description: Key under ``services:`` in the resulting workflow YAML. Used as the deduplication key when multiple providers contribute containers — two containers with the same service_name is a configuration error.
service_name.title: Service Name

env.description: Environment variables passed into the container.
env.title: Env

credentials.description: Registry credentials for pulling private images.
credentials.title: Credentials

ServiceContainer.title: ServiceContainer
